purpose: Preserve assumptions for modelling EVs as a future distributed virtual power plant resource. This is not current dispatchable capacity.

fleet.notes: BEV count based on the Ministry of Transport weekly EV fleet report around 2026-08-16. PHEV count is an approximate current estimate and should be replaced by a direct observed series when available.

base_case_assumptions.rationale: 25% is a deliberately conservative participation/infrastructure assumption. 5 kW derates a typical 7 kW residential charger to allow for practical limits and aggregation losses.

evidence_based_charger_case.notes: EECA 2025 EV charging research reported 75% of BEV users and 55% of PHEV users typically charging at home; among home chargers, dedicated charger use was approximately 47% for BEVs and 51% for PHEVs. Applied to the present fleet mix, this implies roughly one-third of plug-in vehicles may already use dedicated home charging. Dedicated charging does not imply V2G capability.

fleet_ceiling.notes: Pure theoretical ceiling if every current plug-in light vehicle were connected, available, bidirectional and dispatchable at 5 kW.

important_constraints: Most current residential EV chargers are not necessarily bidirectional.
Many vehicles in the present fleet do not support V2G.
Vehicles must be plugged in and opted into aggregation at the relevant dispatch time.
Driver mobility needs impose state-of-charge and availability constraints.
Distribution-network export limits and local congestion may reduce usable aggregate power.
This resource should therefore be modelled as a scenario or flexible-capacity option, not as present firm generation.
recommended_future_inputs: Observed BEV and PHEV fleet counts by month
Share of fleet with dedicated home charging
Share of fleet that is V2G-capable
Share plugged in during each modelled interval
Average allowable export power per vehicle
Average usable V2G energy per vehicle
Distribution-network constraints by region or GXP where available
source_notes: New Zealand Ministry of Transport weekly electric vehicle fleet reporting
